description:
NSWCPD has a requirement for Electrical Hull Penetration Units.  The drawings associated with this requirement have a distribution D CUI statement attached to them.  To view the RFQ, TDP, and drawings a JCP Certification must be submitted.  Please send your company's JCP Certification to zachary.f.mccurry.civ@us.navy.mil.  This pre-solicitation notice closes on 05/07/2026 at COB.  The RFQ and drawings will be issued after the closing of the pre-solicitation notice.

Please email all questions to zachary.f.mccurry.civ@us.navy.mil

Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
